column7:
A circular (https://diavgeia.gov.gr/doc/%CE%A8%CE%94%CE%91046%CE%9C%CE%A4%CE%9B%CE%A0-%CE%A04%CE%92?inline=true) was sent to all public sector bodies requesting a contact point for open data and non-machine readable datasets to be posted on the national portal. A number of bodies have responded with contact points. Of these, few responded with datasets and even fewer were those where these datasets were truly machine readable. In the next phase, communication will follow to support stakeholders in identifying useful datasets and improve their quality even by organising relevant seminars.

RtR: The circular goal is to establish communication with the public bodies where we can in the ensuing discussions a) underline the importance of open data and, thus, motivate them to publish datasets, b) provide help with the dataset publications, minimizing as much as possible their lack of resources and c) jointly determine the challenges for the improvement of data quality of possible datasets.
